## The shots: GDStudio's own work, MIT

The five shots are not ElevenLabs output and stay as they were: GDStudio's own work, synthesised by code, nothing
sampled and nothing third-party. They are the five variants of the House Pistol's shot from Deadnight
(`game/assets/audio/guns/shot_house_pistol_1..5.ogg`), made by Deadnight's `tools/audio/gun_recipes_2.py` (a seeded
report of a click, a crack, a roar, a bark and a low thump), copied here unchanged under the names below, and covered by
the MIT licence of the kit and of Deadnight (Copyright (c) 2026 GDStudio contributors). No attribution is required.

## The whistle in the wind: GDStudio's own work, MIT

`wind_soft_1.ogg` is the ElevenLabs take above with a soft whistle layered over its gusts by `tools/audio/sfx.py`
(`whistle()`: seeded noise through a resonant band-pass whose pitch follows the take's own level). The layer is
synthesised by code, nothing sampled and nothing third-party, and is covered by the MIT licence of the kit
(Copyright (c) 2026 GDStudio contributors); the file as a whole is used under the ElevenLabs terms above.
